exposure: resources for educating patients on COVID-19
outcome: patient preference for birth center births
knowledge about COVID-19 testing and patient education
cohort: The study included 120 responding Utah birth workers (nurse-midwives, community midwives, and doulas) who completed an online survey.
finding: Utah birth workers reported significant changes to clinical practice and patient preferences for birth locations during the COVID-19 pandemic, alongside challenges such as slower hospital transfers and insufficient access to PPE and COVID-19 information for community birth providers.
